name: @limio/ot-store
description: OpenText Business Network store front: hero with region/currency picker, product cards (B2B Integration Essentials, Trading Grid Foundation, Enterprise) with 'from' prices in the shopper's currency, a three-question 'which fits you?' helper, proof stats, how-it-works steps and a talk-to-sales band.

limioProps.label: Headline
limioProps.default: Trade with Walmart, Target, Tesco and a million more — starting today.

limioProps.label: Subheadline
limioProps.default: Buy EDI and B2B integration online, on transparent pricing. Pick your trading partners, check out with a card, and our automation starts setting you up the moment you do.

priceText.label: Price text when no catalog price

default.title: B2B Integration Essentials
default.body:
• Web portal for orders, ASNs and invoices
  • Pre-mapped retailers, no EDI expertise needed
  • 2 to 5 trading partners

default.title: Trading Grid Foundation
default.body:
• Your ERP connected to the Trading Grid
  • AS2, SFTP or VAN connectivity
  • 5 to 10 trading partners, live in as little as 9 days

default.title: Trading Grid Enterprise
default.body:
• Unlimited trading partners and volume
  • Managed services and custom integrations
  • Named account team in your region
